empirical_findings.title: Tip-gated hub visibility (win_tips_count >= 1)
empirical_findings.detail: OLBG sport hubs only render events with at least one active tipster selection. Zero-tip upcoming events (such as 2026 US Grand Prix, Mexico City Grand Prix, and Northern Ireland Open Final prior to SF2 completion) exist at dedicated event URLs but are omitted from hub listings.

empirical_findings.title: Greyhound runner hydration on ?event_id= subpages
empirical_findings.detail: Peer Board CA claimed OLBG greyhound pages expose no runners; direct inspection of /11:04_Doncaster/28?event_id=690043 disproves that claim and reveals named runners (Snowfall, Grouchos Badger, Heathmill Barron, Luminous Dream, Shots Fired), though without trap numbers.

empirical_findings.title: Stale Redis expired='0' cache on commenced fixtures
empirical_findings.detail: OLBG's SSR Redis layer continues serving commenced and completed Oct 24 fixtures with expired='0' for hours after start. Strict UTC timestamp filtering (>= 2026-10-25T00:00:00Z) plus governing-body live-state verification is mandatory.

empirical_findings.title: Handball 3-way 'Money Line' label & single-tip Tie distortion
empirical_findings.detail: On /betting-tips/Handball/20, OLBG labels 60-minute 3-way markets 'Money Line' and highlights 'Tie' as the top tip on Bergischer HC vs HSV Hamburg (765548) and HSG Wetzlar vs SC Magdeburg (765529) based on a single 1/1 contrarian tipster.

empirical_findings.title: Client-side infinite scroll (?from=20 SSR reset)
empirical_findings.detail: Appending ?from=20 to an SSR sport hub resets to an empty state ('No tips found for 20') because pagination beyond the first ~20 SSR rows is fetched client-side from tipsb.olbg.info.

Dedicated event route is live for Sunday Nov 1 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix (71 laps), also suppressed on the main /Motor_Racing/14 hub until its first tip is posted.
